findings.label: Bundled out-of-scope changes
findings.detail: The commit mixes role work with unrelated UI/flow changes (bulk requirements upload, rate-limiter rename to named limiters, public /verify lookup route, applicant payments.proof, CSS cache-busting, Tailwind CDN removal). All are correctly wired, but widen the commit scope past 'add two roles'. Confirm intended or split out.

findings.label: Tailwind CDN removal is a visual-risk change
findings.detail: layouts/app.blade.php no longer loads cdn.tailwindcss.com; views relying on Tailwind utility classes now render only against public/css/app.css. Worth a visual smoke check across BPLO/admin/applicant pages before shipping.

findings.label: Treasurer index status filter lists PENDING but confirm only acts on PROCESSING/UNVERIFIED
findings.detail: The treasurer payment index can surface payments the Treasurer cannot act on. The show-page guard isAwaitingVerification() handles it safely, so this is a UX note, not a bug.
